test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Somebody is following us.

options.text: We have been following by somebody.

solution:
The correct answer is option ) i.e. 'We’re being followed by somebody.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice. We have to change the sentence into passive form. 
 
• The given sentence is written in 'present continuous tense.'
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Active Voice: Sub + is/am/are + V1+ ing + obj
 
• Passive Voice: Obj + is/am/are + being + V3 + by (preposition) + Subject.
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:
 
 
• Active voice: I am calling the cab driver.
 
• Passive voice: The cab driver is being called by me.
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'Somebody' and the object of the given sentence is 'us'. 
 
• So, in the passive voice, the position of ‘subject’ and ‘object’ will be interchanged. 
 
• 'us' will be changed into 'We'.
 
• Also here, 'is following' will be changed into 'are being followed'.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *We’re being followed by somebody.*
